MAKKALAI THEDI MARUTHUVAM (DOORSTEP HEALTHCARE SCHEME) 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
A pioneering community healthcare scheme delivering essential healthcare services, non-communicable disease (NCD) screening, and free medications directly to the doorsteps of citizens across Tamil Nadu. 
 
2. 
Objective 
To screen for hypertension and diabetes, provide palliative care, dialysis assistance, and physiotherapy at home, reducing out-of-pocket medical expenditure for elderly and bedridden patients. 
 
3. 
Eligibility & Beneficiaries 
- Citizens above 45 years of age for NCD screening.
- Elderly citizens, bedridden patients, persons requiring palliative care or home physiotherapy, and chronic kidney disease patients.
- Available to all residents of Tamil Nadu free of cost.
 
4. 
Services Provided 
- Doorstep delivery of monthly hypertension and diabetes medications.
- Home-based palliative care, home dialysis bag delivery, and physiotherapy for mobility-impaired patients.
- Free screening for hypertension, diabetes, breast cancer, and cervical cancer by Women Health Volunteers (WHVs).
 
5. 
Department 
Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
